facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, through authorised channels; pricing in foreign currency to Rwandans is banned.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: licensed foreign-currency accounts are permitted.
facts.P3_local_gateways: IremboPay and Paystack need RDB business registration and a TIN.
facts.L1_registration: Register an individual enterprise free and instantly online at RDB, with automatic TIN.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from the Rwanda Revenue Authority, issued automatically with RDB registration.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 0–30%; turnover under RWF 2m is exempt.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18% VAT above RWF 20m a year; exports are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 058/2021: register with the National Cyber Security Authority as a data controller.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can withdraw from online purchases within 7 days (Law 011/2026).
facts.L7_incentives: No income tax under RWF 2m; simple flat or 3% taxes up to RWF 20m.

watch_out.text: Quoting prices in foreign currency to Rwandan customers can bring heavy fines.
Online businesses face new disclosure duties under Law 011/2026.
